title: Open extension commutes with the canonical scheme/Galois comparison
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and the finite coefficient ring $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, with $\ell\ne p$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite and $n\geq1$, of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Let $j_0:X_0\hookrightarrow Y_0$ be an open immersion of separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, let $j:X\hookrightarrow Y$ be its base change to $k$, and fix $m\geq1$. Write $\Phi_X,\Phi_Y$ and $g_X,g_Y$ for the scheme and geometric Galois Frobenii [def-trf-scheme-frobenius]. Use extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero] and derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] at $A$. Let $\kappa_{m,X}$ and $\kappa_{m,Y}$ be the comparisons [prop-trf-scheme-galois-comparison], each specified by the factorization [prop-trf-frobenius-factorization], canonical pullback composition [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition] and absolute-Frobenius trivialization [lem-trf-absolute-frobenius-site]. For $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ write
$$
b_{\Phi,m,M}:L(\Phi_Y^m)^*j_!M\xrightarrow{\sim}j_!L(\Phi_X^m)^*M,\qquad
b_{g,m,M}:L(g_Y^m)^*j_!M\xrightarrow{\sim}j_!L(g_X^m)^*M
$$
for the canonical exchanges [lem-trf-open-square-exchange] of the Cartesian squares [lem-trf-frobenius-open-square]. Then
$$
b_{g,m,M}\circ\kappa_{m,Y,j_!M}=j_!(\kappa_{m,X,M})\circ b_{\Phi,m,M}.
$$
The equality is natural in $M$ and holds for every $m\geq1$.

proof.text: Let J be exact derived open extension and R intrinsic derived restriction. Use the existing exceptionalOpenAdjunction J ⊣ R from prop-exc-open-adjoint. Its unit equals sfIntrinsicDerivedOpenUnit: precompose with the derived localization functor, expand the localized adjunction unit, and cancel the exact identity and composition factorization isomorphisms. This is exactDerivedAdjunction_unit in Lean.

Let bP and bG be the two exchange isomorphisms for the Cartesian squares of lem-trf-frobenius-open-square. Invert the restriction equation of lem-trf-open-square-exchange to obtain eta at p(M) followed by R(bP inverse) = p(eta_M) followed by alpha_P at J(M), and likewise for q and bG. Conjugate by the unit-preserving tensor/intrinsic coordinate comparisons. Naturality of these comparisons and eta preserves this equation. This is constantExchange_inverse_unit.

Apply lem-trf-scheme-galois-pullback-naturality to j0 and the supplied Frobenius-square commutativity equalities. This gives alpha_P followed by R(kappa_Y) = kappa_X at R followed by alpha_G on the full derived categories.

For each M, precompose the desired equality by bP inverse and postcompose by bG inverse. It becomes an equality between maps J(pM) to Q(JM). Apply injectivity of the open-adjunction Hom equivalence. Its two adjuncts agree by Step 2, the restriction naturality in Step 3, naturality of kappa_X at eta_M, and naturality of eta at kappa_X(M). Cancel the two exchange inverses. This is the fully proved categorical exchange_naturality_of_mates calculation; no full faithfulness or invertibility of eta is needed. Extend component equality to natural transformations and whisker with the D^b_ctf inclusion, obtaining the original statement unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Step 2, using the separate source pullback-naturality equation and injectivity of the open-adjunction Hom bijection in place of the original full-faithfulness detour.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q155-f018a7aae (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole item and every cited statement. I also read the parent's citing step, the blueprint (main-20261015) prop-trf-graph-frobenius-operator proof Step 2, and the blueprint_update construction of kappa in prop-trf-scheme-galois-comparison. The delivery has no new nodes and leaves the statement unchanged. Statement checks: g_X and g_Y are the geometric Frobenius g_gamma = g_sigma^{-1}, the same as in lem-trf-frobenius-open-square. The coefficient category is the ordinary D(Z_proet, A) with A = O_E/varpi^n, which is annihilated by l^n with l != p. Both squares are Cartesian by lem-trf-frobenius-open-square, and b goes Lh^*j_! -> j_!Lh^*, the direction of lem-trf-open-square-exchange. X_0 is of finite type because it is open in the noetherian Y_0. Step 1: Fr^{(q^m)} = g_sigma^m Phi^m, so Phi^m = g^m F^{am}; I checked this on sections and on Spec k_0. kappa = t∘c is exactly the specified construction. Step 2: I recomputed both reassociations from the local formula of lem-sf-proetale-tensor-composition-unit and got v⊗c_h c_k(a) c_h(b) d both times. Exactness and clause (3) of the localization node carry the equality to the derived category. Step 3: lem-pur-frobenius-trivialization-pullback with u = j, b = am gives the restriction equation, and its trivialization is the same iterate as in Step 1. Steps 4 to 7: I recomputed every composite and its types. The naturality of t, the two normalization equations, cancelling the invertible nu, and the full-faithfulness lift through b_P^{-1} all hold. Edge cases j = id, X_0 empty, M = 0 and m = 1 behave correctly. Duplicate search: no node in the DAG or the blueprint states this square; lem-trf-compactification-graph-operator gives only the exchange b_m, without kappa. I accept the declared tool_uses: each is a coherence interface that the item's statement or the blueprint's Step 2 already prescribes. No SGA source is used and no fixes were written.
